figures.name: action_error_by_dimension
figures.caption: Existing M03 errors include all eight predicted slots, not only executed slots. Episode-level errors are averaged within task, then suite, then across suites. Action commands are not physical displacement distances.

figures.name: gpu_costs
figures.caption: Slurm allocation time is preferred, including startup failures before CUDA initialized. Explicitly labelled process-time fallback is retained in GPU_COST.csv. CPU-only allocation contributes zero GPU hours; this is allocation time, not measured GPU utilization.
